title: Conditions for Opening an In-Place Home Resale File
content:
**Conditions of opening.** Holding a site lease is what makes an in-place sale possible: only the leaseholder of the site may open an In-Place Home Resale file for the home on it, and the seller's site lease must be active or under notice to vacate.

1. **Seller holds the lease.** The site lease named on the file is the seller's, and the company's lease record shows it as active or under notice to vacate before the file is opened. The lease record governs; the seller's own description of the lease does not replace it.
2. **Entry requirements.** The home and the package must meet the package's entry requirements. A sale in which the buyer will remove the home from the community is not handled under the resale program; the seller must instead give a notice to vacate.
3. **Lienholder.** The lienholder on the home's title is recorded when the file is opened. A lien held by another lender must be released by that lender at closing under its own payoff letter, which the resident desk does not obtain.
4. **Package service fee.** The package's service fee is charged on the opening date, is due within the package's upfront-fee due period in calendar days, and is not refunded if the file is later withdrawn or expires.
5. **The lease is unchanged.** Opening a file never changes the seller's lease: rent stays due on the lease until the sale closes.

| Seller's lease status on the lease record | File may be opened on that lease |
|---|---|
| active | yes |
| under notice to vacate | yes |
| any other status | no |

## Questions answered by these conditions

**May an adult occupant who is not the leaseholder open a file for the home?** No. Only the leaseholder of the site may open the file.

**Does a seller who opens a file stop owing site rent?** No. Rent stays due on the lease until the sale closes.

**Is the package service fee returned if the seller withdraws the file before listing?** No. It is not refunded if the file is later withdrawn or expires.

**Illustration (hypothetical).** A file opened on 4 May on the Owner-Marketed Listing Package is charged that package's service fee on 4 May, due within the package's due period of calendar days; the seller's rent continues to fall due on the lease as before.
